base.matrix: auth-contract-matrix.json referenced by OpenAPI; location not found in this worktree, resolve before projection
base.precedence: Apply prior approved overlay first where applicable; then these explicit deltas. Semantic proposal, not OpenAPI or JSON Patch.

cases.marker: direct-v2 refresh in LEGACY cookie mode or new mutation when gate disabled
cases.note: LEGACY mode blocks both new direct refresh and exact credential/cookie replay with 503 AUTH_STATE_UNAVAILABLE and no token or Set-Cookie. Authorized read-only status remains separate. Headerless legacy remains unchanged in LEGACY mode; GENERATION_SCOPED applies the explicit markerless cutover rejection. Generic 503 does not prove disabled or no commit.

allowed_when: ACTIVE flow and canonical authenticated session
new UUID and immutable client expiry persisted and read back
current live execution has not dispatched this UUID
server locking and browser-cookie activation gates passed
live document generated and persisted its own tuple, and has direct in-memory evidence that this exact tuple was not dispatched; copied sessionStorage alone is not provenance
first_dispatch.never: retry a lost operation automatically or disguise it as a new ID

same_epoch_competition.linearization: MySQL flow lock and atomic commit
same_epoch_competition.a_first: Previously sent A may commit if valid; B has already been dispatched, and after B loses no retry or replacement ID is sent.

loser.condition: Use exact route-allowed error corresponding to proved state and security filter precedence; do not assert every stale cookie is a 409.

success.set_cookie: physical lines for this result generation only; never overwrite or delete later generation

receipt_first_proof_order.prelock: Validate marker, structural headers and CSRF/Origin without requiring current-generation flow proof. Resolve flow safely without revealing identity from unauthenticated inputs.
under_flow_lock: Locate exact flow/kind/operationId receipt or tombstone before applying new-ID current-proof and epoch gates.

Live receipt: compare original stored flow and refresh HMAC in constant time OR exact canonical result proof, then verify identity, expiry, cutoff and canonical result. In LEGACY mode no credential/cookie replay: return 503 AUTH_STATE_UNAVAILABLE after security checks; authenticated read-only status remains available.

Scrubbed tombstone or absent receipt: validate current DB-selected flow proof and refresh/session proof independently of ID existence; missing or invalid flow proof yields 428, invalid refresh/session proof yields 401 independent of receipt presence. Valid proof allows same-epoch tombstone expired, different-epoch ID_REUSED.
Absent receipt requires current proof, starting epoch, unexpired original client expiry and canonical session before new mutation. LEGACY mode blocks all direct refresh, including replay.
receipt_first_proof_order.failure: Ambiguous flow, invalid proof, unavailable state or missing required evidence fail closed without credentials or Set-Cookie.

definitive_b_loss.normative_meaning: This code on direct refresh is reserved for a proven uncommitted new-ID loser whose durable negative tombstone has committed; it must not be emitted for potentially committed B.
all_conditions: flow lock held; exact B receipt and tombstone absent
A is live canonical winner and result remains valid
B original flow and refresh proofs match A original fingerprints in constant time
B presented previous generation and lost the current state race
the server has not committed B and can guarantee B cannot subsequently commit under that tuple
create and commit a durable negative B tombstone in the same transaction before sending 409
reserve capacity and successfully persist tombstone; limit or DB failure cannot emit definitive code
definitive_b_loss.other_ambiguous_failures: Use route-allowed 428/409/503 without mislabeling as definitive; FE preserves B. If this stronger code meaning cannot be guaranteed, B deletion is disabled until a distinct verified wire signal is designed.
frontend: verify response status and exact code under this contract
compare all four stored fields to dispatched B
delete only exact B and read back empty
user-initiated current-operation GET and exact A tuple readback
separate user action before authorized same-ID A recovery

negative_tombstone.scope: flowId, kind=REFRESH, operationId B, startingEpoch; negative terminal state and purge deadline
negative_tombstone.scrub: no tokens, cookie values, proofs, HMAC fingerprints, ciphertext or credential result
negative_tombstone.repeated_b: after independent route authorization, matching identity and epoch => 409 AUTH_OPERATION_RECEIPT_EXPIRED, mismatched epoch => 409 AUTH_OPERATION_ID_REUSED; neither returns credentials or Set-Cookie
negative_tombstone.proof_privacy: Independently validate current canonical flow generation and proof plus DB-selected refresh proof and active canonical session. Invalid flow proof yields receipt-independent 428; invalid refresh/session proof yields receipt-independent 401. Binding proof alone cannot authorize refresh POST.
negative_tombstone.admission: Under flow-first lock count and atomically insert plus commit under the shared flow-wide 20 rejections per 900 seconds budget, including negative REFRESH. No forced eviction; cap, DB failure or uncertain commit => 503 AUTH_STATE_UNAVAILABLE, no definitive response; FE preserves B.
negative_tombstone.limit: Protection lasts until physical purge under documented 24h horizon; do not assert indefinite ID prohibition.

all_failure_responses.commit_inference: No credentials alone does not prove no commit; only definitive_b_loss carries the specified no-commit meaning. Transport errors, 5xx and all other ambiguous outcomes preserve B.
all_failure_responses.scope: Application-generated direct refresh failures; upstream gateway 502/504 is external infrastructure and cannot be promised by the application. FE treats such responses as ambiguous and retains B.

db_authority_projection_failure.success_condition: writer DB confirms session, receipt and required outbox commit and canonical result; immediate Hazelcast projection failure alone does not turn success into failure
db_authority_projection_failure.projection: leave delivery pending for durable retry; MySQL writer is authentication authority
db_authority_projection_failure.unknown_condition: DB or required outbox commit outcome or canonical validation unavailable
db_authority_projection_failure.frontend: preserve exact operation tuple; no automatic retransmission; gateway 502/504, timeout and disconnect are ambiguous independently
db_authority_projection_failure.status: proposed; actual OpenAPI projection and paired tests required

updates.source_recovery: Use existing canonical REFRESH currentOperation with original flowId, startingEpoch, operationId, clientExpiresAt and effectiveExpiresAt, plus DB-bound binding and applicable replay proof. Verify schema and readback; explicit user action before mutation.
updates.superseded_or_missing_proof: No recovery POST; reauthenticate when proof recovery is unavailable. null is not evidence A was never sent.
updates.binding_only: proofState REBOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED; binding does not authorize ordinary refresh

updates.refresh_first: If a valid identifiable original proof establishes the older logout tuple is superseded, propose 409 AUTH_OPERATION_SUPERSEDED, no token or Set-Cookie. Invalid or missing usable proof follows existing 428 AUTH_FLOW_COOKIE_INVALID or AUTH_FLOW_REQUIRED, rather than assuming an epoch change.
updates.frontend: Do not mark logout complete. No automatic replay or tuple rewrite. Explicit proof recovery and user-initiated new logout only after canonical state is established; otherwise reauthenticate/fail closed.
updates.logout_first: Once logout commits, earlier refresh cannot issue credentials or Set-Cookie; actual route-specific 409, 428 or 401 follows proof/state validation.

retention.server_cutoff: min(client expiry, first DB receipt plus 900 seconds, receipt expiry); recovery also clamps to source cutoff and source receipt expiry
retention.tombstone: scrub credential/proof payload; after independent current canonical route proof, matching epoch returns 409 AUTH_OPERATION_RECEIPT_EXPIRED. Negative tombstone retains 86400 seconds from commit, full receipt tombstone 86400 seconds from effective deadline. Original client expiry remains binding after purge; indefinite ID uniqueness is not promised.

activation_and_rollback.reentry_requires: GENERATION_SCOPED mode and verified cookie isolation, DB fence, origin/csrf, capacity/eviction and actual browser/MySQL races
activation_and_rollback.legacy_fixed_name: DB cookie_mode LEGACY blocks all direct-v2 refresh mutation AND existing exact credential/cookie replay with 503 AUTH_STATE_UNAVAILABLE and no token or Set-Cookie. Proof-checked read-only status remains separate; marker-absent legacy route remains unchanged. Roll-forward cutover and fixed-name fencing need separate proof.
activation_and_rollback.application_rollback: After generation-scoped cutover, gate off and roll back only to a verified binary compatible with both the current schema and generation-scoped cookies; fixed-cookie-only binaries are prohibited. No direct marker fallback to legacy.
activation_and_rollback.schema: forward-only compatible migration; keep schema and roll forward. Never modify applied Flyway or automatically roll back schema; establish compatibility before application rollback

expect.unauthorized: generic failure without receipt identity disclosure

verification: Current 771bb76 OpenAPI has NOT been projected with this overlay; proposed proof, quota, retention and privacy semantics require contract projection, implementation and synchronized matrix, FE/BE parsers and tests. This is not implementation or test evidence.

db_authority_login_refresh.committed_canonical_plus_hazelcast_failu: 200 success with canonical credentials and generation cookies; durable outbox retry
db_authority_login_refresh.db_outbox_commit_or_canonical_unknown: 503 AUTH_STATE_UNAVAILABLE without credentials; operation may already be committed

markerless_cutover.legacy_mode: existing markerless refresh route remains unchanged
markerless_cutover.generation_scoped_mode: reject markerless fixed-cookie refresh mutation with 503 AUTH_STATE_UNAVAILABLE, no token, no Set-Cookie and no fallback
markerless_cutover.pre_cutover_gate: compatible clients and proof that old processes and in-flight fixed-cookie responses cannot affect new authority; otherwise OFF
markerless_cutover.status: proposed; implementation and actual browser verification required
